title: Scorch
description: Your recently played covers stacked like sheets of paper, with each artwork’s dark ink as the fuel. Hold still on the lettering until it catches and a glowing char line races along it like a fuse, leaving pale paper standing and burning through to the cover underneath.
intent: A heat-and-fuel burn sim where bare paper barely smoulders and the cover’s dark ink burns like a fuse, so lighting the lettering yourself is the moment.
